preconditions.description: The number of knitting needles K must be between 1 and 50000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= 999 and 1 <= y <= 999 and 1 <= z <= 999 for x, y, z in coordinates)
preconditions.description: Each coordinate of the knitting needles must be between 1 and 999.
All knitting needles must have unique sets of triples.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'True closed chains' if true_closed_chain else 'No true closed chains'
postconditions.description: The output must indicate whether there is a true closed chain in the sculpture.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'Floor closed chains' if floor_closed_chain else 'No floor closed chains'
postconditions.description: The output must indicate whether there is a floor closed chain in the sculpture.
